text: Bitcoin is holding steady above $82k with modest gains while Ethereum lags slightly, suggesting measured confidence in the majors without aggressive conviction. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory but has declined notably over the past week, indicating sentiment is cooling from earlier peaks. Bitcoin dominance at 59.2% and $77B in daily volume point to a market in equilibrium—neither heavily risk-on nor defensive, with capital relatively distributed across the ecosystem.
